scriptData.label: @effect.name

description.label: Description
description.value:
The arrowhead slices into the crook of your elbow, severing one of the arteries to the lower arm where it branches off from the larger brachial artery. Blood starts spurting!

Effects: Gain @Condition[Bleeding] (2) and suffer a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.GlShFJF2TpsNh1FX]{Torn Muscle (Minor)}. Also, the blood streaming down your arm is good enough for an extra -10 penalty to any Tests using that hand due to a slippery grip, until the @Condition[Bleeding] Conditions have been removed.

Extraction will be Average (+20).
